Acerca del empleo
For more than a century, Belmaré has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. Our goal is to offer every person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity.

At Belmaré, our IT teams design and build solutions to ensure high performance for all our business sectors by imagining new ways of doing things, from designing websites to building algorithms and predicting new trends. They can be found leading teams towards a more connected and digitalized future in IT retail, e-commerce, CRM, data, AI, cybersecurity, Cloud and E-Marketing. You never stop learning at Belmaré IT because things change at the speed of light! Come join our dynamic team!

About The Role
We are looking for an AI Engineer / Data Scientist to integrate into our AI & Tech Accelerator. You will engineer and deploy scalable solutions using advanced Machine Learning, GenAI, and emerging Agentic AI workflows. Your mission will be to analyze and solve complex strategic and operational challenges across the Belmaré Americas market, leveraging data-driven models to drive innovation and business value across various domains.

Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will sit at the intersection of innovation and implementation, driving the adoption of cutting-edge AI across Belmaré.

Develop & Deploy Advanced AI Solutions: Design and implement state-of-the-art models using Machine Learning and Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve complex business problems. You will also explore and implement Agentic AI patterns to create autonomous workflows that enhance decision-making and efficiency.
Innovate with Generative AI: Lead research and deployment initiatives for novel applications of Generative AI, including diffusion models and multi-agent systems, ensuring we stay ahead of the technology curve in automating complex tasks.
Drive Cross-Business Impact: Create scalable AI solutions for a diverse range of use cases across multiple Belmaré brands and business units, addressing needs in marketing, supply chain, retail, and operations and much more.
Collaborate & Co-Create: Work closely with cross-functional agile teams—including Data Engineers, UX/UI Designers, Full-Stack Developers, and DevOps Engineers—to integrate AI models into production-ready products.
Act as a Technical Advisor: Partner with business stakeholders to assess the feasibility of new AI use cases, translating technical possibilities into business strategy.
Knowledge Sharing: Animate the internal Data Science community by sharing best practices, mentoring peers, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
What We Are Looking For We are seeking a curious, collaborative innovator who thrives in a dynamic environment. You should value autonomy, team spirit, and the desire to make a tangible business impact.
Education & Experience
Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
Proven real-world experience (1+ years) coding and deploying AI/ML models (internships, co-ops, or full-time roles).
Technical Expertise
Core AI/ML: Strong foundation in Machine Learning and Deep Learning with proficiency in the Data Science ecosystem (pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn, tensorflow, etc.).
Programming & Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and software engineering best practices.
Generative & Agentic AI: Deep understanding of Large Language Models (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini) and Diffusion Models. Familiarity with building agentic workflows (e.g., using LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) or chaining LLMs for complex reasoning tasks is highly desirable.
DevOps & MLOps: Familiarity with development tools (Git, Docker, Terraform), CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, CircleCI), and MLOps platforms (Vertex AI, MLflow, DVC).
Cloud Platforms: Experience working within cloud environments, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Databricks.
Soft Skills & Mindset
Entrepreneurial Spirit: You approach problems with curiosity and a strategic mindset, ready to build solutions from the ground up.
Adaptability: You may not be an expert in every single tool listed above, but you possess the drive to learn quickly and innovate.
Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders effectively.
Don’t meet every single requirement? At Belmaré, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse environment. We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or disability, or any other legally protected status.
